_AboutFileName: The file is expected to be named in a bulletSensor+nameId+macAddr format.
_lastEditTime: The unix timestamp (GMT time) of last edit time.
_haveConfiguredToSensor: To indicate whether the sensor has been configured
_whenConfiguredToSensor: A unix timestamp (GMT time) representing when the sensor has been configured. This field is valid when haveConfiguredToSensor is true
_nameId: A 4-byte hash ID to avoid the same name. nameId is the index.
_macAddr: BLE MAC address of the sensor (separated by dashes)

sysConfig._sensorModeParameter: 0/1/2/3 representing regular sensing only/regular sensing only/3 axial status sensing only/both regular sensing and 3 axial status sensing are activated. The parameter of sensor work mode.
sysConfig._batteryAlarmThreshold: A low battery alarm threshold (in percentage). For instance, 20 means low battery alarm would be reported when the battery volume is lower than 20%.
sysConfig._currentTime: A unix timestamp (GMT time), used to set time of the sensor, which can be regarded as the last communication time.
sysConfig._txPower_adv: 0/-4/-8 representing 0 dBm/-4 dBm/-8 dBm. Transmit power of BLE advertising.
sysConfig._dataRate_auxAdv: 125/500/1000/2000 representing 125 kbps/500 kbps/1 Mbps/2 Mbps. Data rate of BLE advertising (as a non-standard auxiliary advertising to improve communication range).
sysConfig._txPower_auxAdv: 0/-4/-8 representing 0 dBm/-4 dBm/-8 dBm. Transmit power of BLE advertising (as a non-standard auxiliary advertising).

scheduleConfig._period_quickPolling: Quick polling period in second. Zero represents no periodic quick polling.
scheduleConfig._referenceTime_quickPolling: A unix timestamp (GMT time), used as the start time of periodic quick polling.
scheduleConfig._period_regularSensing: Regular sensing period in second. Zero represents periodic regular sensing.
scheduleConfig._referenceTime_regularSensing: A unix timestamp (GMT time), used as the start time of periodic regular sensing.
scheduleConfig._period_comm: BLE communication in second. Zero is not allowed.
scheduleConfig._referenceTime_period_comm: A unix timestamp (GMT time), used as the start time of periodic BLE communication.
scheduleConfig._waveDataAcqPeriod: The period (in S) to upload waveform data
scheduleConfig._waveDataAcqReference: A unix timestamp (GMT time), used as the start time of periodic waveform uploading.

sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_VIB_FS_HZ: The vibration sensing frequency in Hz for the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_VIB_N: The number of vibration sensing for the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_VIB_AXIS_ACQ_EVAL: 1/2/4 indicates DIMENSION_X/DIMENSION_Y/DIMENSION_Z. A mask to indicate which axis (axes) is/are sampled during vibration sensing of the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_VIB_RANGE: 16/8/4/2 indicates +- 16g/8g/4g/2g. The range of the vibration sensor (in gee) of the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_MAG_FS_HZ: The magnetic field sensing frequency in Hz for the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_MAG_N: The number of magnetic field sensing frequency for the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._PRE_ACQ_MAG_AXIS_ACQ_EVAL: 1/2/4 indicates DIMENSION_X/DIMENSION_Y/DIMENSION_Z. A mask to indicate which axis (axes) is/are sampled during magnetic field sensing of the pre-acquisition.
sensingConfig._Facc: The vibration sensing frequency in Hz for the acquisition.
sensingConfig._Nacc: The number of vibration sensing frequency for the acquisition.
sensingConfig._ACQ_VIB_AXIS_ACQ_EVAL: 1/2/4 indicates DIMENSION_X/DIMENSION_Y/DIMENSION_Z. A mask to indicate which axis (axes) is/are sampled during vibration sensing of the acquisition.
sensingConfig._ACQ_VIB_RANGE: 16/8/4/2 indicates +- 16g/8g/4g/2g. The range of the vibration sensor (in gee) of the acquisition.
sensingConfig._ACQ_MAG_FS_HZ: The number of magnetic field sensing frequency for the acquisition.
sensingConfig._ACQ_MAG_N: The number of magnetic field sensing frequency for the acquisition.
sensingConfig._ACQ_MAG_AXIS_ACQ_EVAL: 1/2/4 indicates DIMENSION_X/DIMENSION_Y/DIMENSION_Z. A mask to indicate which axis (axes) is/are sampled during magnetic field sensing of the acquisition.
sensingConfig._FS_COEF: A fixed value for bullet sensor.

_bulletConfig: bulletConfig is expected if the sensor is a Bullet sensor.
